scope: Mac Studio top control bar only, 2026-10-31

reference.note: Published listing image normalized from 2880 pixels. Approximate screenshot measurements, not native point measurements or proof of a new capture for each release.

implementation.compact: Hide secondary utilities; preserve transport, LCD and Back to Explore. Master remains visible above 640px.
implementation.symbols: Separate authored top-bar SVG catalogue and CSS chevron; no extracted Apple artwork

iconRefinement.concepts: Layered music library, paired inspector toggles, dial with ticks, capped mixer faders, filled pencil, segmented recording ring, repeat arrows, angled tuner, loop symbol and media browser
iconRefinement.selectedState: Editors aria-pressed follows actual lower-editor visibility from either toggle
iconRefinement.geometry: Approved bar grid, button boxes and group positions retained

evidence.liveChecks: Five window sizes, light/dark, common centerline, no group collision or clipped controls; playback, metronome, cycle, keyboard project settings and master gain
evidence.previewChecks: Three sizes, light/dark, no engine/API calls
evidence.limitations: Chromium renderer evidence on Linux. Native AppKit/WKWebView and macOS 26 validation remain pending. Different session, playback state, authored icons and font rendering; no exact pixel-parity claim.
